historical_record.description: The Recreation Commission engaged William G. Merchant, architect, to plan a playground and playground buildings for the Sunset Community Center, the area between 37th and 41st Avenues and Ortega and Quintara Streets.
The Recreation and Park Commission reviewed the planting, rough grading and erosion control plans for the West Sunset Community Center, drawn by Wurster, Bernardi and Emmons, architects.
